Product security starts with design.
Empower product security teams with design-led AI agents that embed security into design and planning, making secure decisions instinctive for developers, product managers, and AI agents alike.
Book a demo
Trusted by world-recognized brands
Builders move fast with AI.
Security should, too.
Clover’s AI agents plug into the tools builders use, from design to code, turning product context into real-time security insights. They detect risks early, suggest secure patterns, and automate reviews so prevention becomes as natural as building.
Use Cases
Making security-by-design second nature for both humans and AI agents.
UC.01
Automate security design reviews.
Clover ensures every product change automatically receives a complete security design review. Continuously assembling the right context and assessing threats and requirements against your policies.
Learn more
UC.02
Detect and prioritize design risk.
Clover pinpoints critical design risks early
so security teams can get involved in time.
Learn more
UC.03
Empower builders with real time security guidance.
Developers and product managers get precise guidance as they work, turning secure decisions into second nature.
Learn more
UC.04
Identify drifts between design and implementation.
Clover continuously compares design and implementation to reveal design drift before it gets to production.
Learn more
UC.05
Elevate security standards & policies.
Clover uplifts your security baseline through living standards that improve and evolve over time.
Learn more
UC.06
Provide security guardrails for AI.
Enable builders to accelerate delivery with AI while maintaining clear visibility into changes and enforcing the security controls required to ship with confidence.
Learn more
